most_similar_reason: Candidate 10, like the target, centers on a light-bringing creator/culture hero who destroys or replaces an earlier failed race of beings and fashions the present humankind, teaches civilization and useful plants, and finally departs in a miraculous self-removal with the promise/expectation of return, with several competing variant genealogies attached to him.
